title: In re the Marriage of Willow Spindale and Cedar Rillmere
forum: Hennepin County District Court, Family Division; dissolution with custody

timeline.event: Parents tested a weekend exchange schedule
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for thirteen days after signing

documents.title: Family motion hearing notice
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The ordinary temporary-custody motion hearing is set for forty days after it was scheduled. No emergency, post-trial motion, or special scheduling order. Client is moving for a stable exchange schedule.

documents.title: Exchange schedule proposal
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The puppet trunk travels with Finn for weekend performances. The proposed exchange includes a trunk checklist and one neutral pickup point; it is not an existing order.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 6: Counsel will deliver the motion draft and proposed exchange schedule. Delivery is due thirteen calendar days after the client workplan was signed. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Agreed delivery of custody schedule draft

clientFacing.status: We are preparing a temporary exchange schedule for the hearing.
